Spawns a <special/>Special Ammo Brick upon scoring a Weapon Kill after reaching 100% Counter Progress. Counter is only progressed by Weapon Kills.

Counter Progress on Weapon Kills:
1.66% to 1.8%. Average of 57.25 Kills.

Progress Multiplier on Kills by Weapon Type:
• <primary/>Primary Weapons: 3.25x
• <yellow Exotic /> <primary/><yellow Primary Weapons: /> 4.75x 
• <special/><green Special Weapons: /> 1.1x
